citation.title: Clinical parameters that affect performance and patient satisfaction of root-retained overdentures: A systematic review of randomised controlled clinical trials
citation.authors: Aspasia Pachiou, Panagiotis Karakostas, Panagiotis Roulias, Olga Naka

s_design.anchor: SR of randomised controlled clinical trials without meta-analysis (THERAPY SR/MA row, 100)
s_design.evidence_quote: The systematic search included only randomised controlled clinical trials (RCTs)

domains.note: Absence under FULL_TEXT: read Abstract, Materials and Methods (search strategy, eligibility, screening, data extraction, quality assessment), Results, Discussion, Conclusion and the Acknowledgments/COI blocks; no registration, protocol or PROSPERO wording anywhere, only a PRISMA-guideline statement.

domains.evidence_quote: an electronic search in the following databases: PubMed, Cochrane Library and Scopus
domains.note: three databases searched, above the 2-database threshold

domains.evidence_quote: studies were excluded due to the type of study (non RCTs).
domains.note: 3b-iii branch 2: screening account with counts reported in Results (137 results + 18 hand-search = 155 articles; 31 chosen for full-text analysis; 7 with unavailable data and 13 non-RCTs excluded; 11 included; Figure 1 PRISMA flow) and explicit eligibility/exclusion criteria stated in Methods; the 13 non-RCT exclusions are cited by number but the 7 excluded for unavailable data are not individually identified, so no full list with reasons.

domains.domain: risk of bias assessment of included studies
domains.evidence_quote: Quality assessment of the included studies was conducted according to the Cochrane Risk of Bias tool.
domains.note: Cochrane RoB tool applied by two independent reviewers (Methods, Tables 2 and 3)

no pooling performed, so no meta-analytical method exists to rate; the text addresses the point (not feasible due to heterogeneity and risk of bias) which is the partial-address case. Does not change the multiplier since two other domains are high.

Absence under FULL_TEXT: read Abstract, Methods (data extraction, quality assessment), Results, Discussion (strengths and limitations) and Conclusion; no publication-bias, funnel plot, small-study or reporting-bias-across-studies wording anywhere.

penalties.item: no conflict-of-interest statement, or commercial-manufacturer funding without independent analysis
penalties.evidence_quote: All authors state that there are no conflicts of interest to declare.
penalties.note: CoI statement present; no financial support from companies declared

penalties.item: clinical trial not prospectively registered (RCTs only)
penalties.note: not applicable: a systematic review, not a clinical trial; missing protocol registration already counted in Q_method (covered in Q_method)

penalties.item: no sample size justification / power analysis
penalties.note: not applicable to a secondary study

penalties.item: follow-up shorter than the outcome plausibly requires
penalties.note: does not fire: the review states no short-follow-up limitation of its included studies and reports no follow-up range of its own; its limitations name the small number of RCTs, variable methods and heterogeneity only

sources.fact_fa: امتیاز DES این مرور سیستماتیک 30 از ۱۰۰ و در باند D (شواهد ضعیف) برای پرسش از نوع درمان (THERAPY) است.
sources.interpretation_fa: این مرور سیستماتیک ۱۱ کارآزمایی تصادفی‌شده را بررسی کرده، اما ثبت پروتکل و ارزیابی سوگیری انتشار در آن گزارش نشده است. ۹ مطالعه از ۱۱ مطالعه در ارزیابی ریسک سوگیری پرخطر بودند و متاآنالیز ممکن نشد. خود نویسندگان برای نتیجه‌گیری قطعی‌تر، کارآزمایی‌های بهتر طراحی‌شده‌ی بیشتری را لازم می‌دانند.
